sloka: नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदम्ष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाद्वै पुरन्दरः ।पुनर्माम् सद्वितीयेन शरेण निहनिष्यति ॥६-१२-३८॥।।
transliteration: nardatastīkṣṇadamṣṭrasya bibhīyādvai purandaraḥ ।punarmām sadvitīyena śareṇa nihaniṣyati ॥6-12-38॥।।

translations.english: "By the time he releases a second arrow again, I will immediately drink his blood. Stay quiet with confidence."
